title: hieracium maculatum subsp. arrectarium
intro: Hieracium maculatum subsp. arrectarium, commonly known as spotted hawk's beard, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium maculatum subsp. arrectarium include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
